name: Vjushkovisaurus
isnote: PBDB places it in Rauisuchidae (a grade of 'rauisuchians'); the atlas keeps that parent.
sum: Vjushkovisaurus is an archosauriform from the Middle Triassic Donguz Gorizont of Orenburg Oblast, Russia.
